description: Takes a whole Gmail conversation out of Trash: every message in the thread, in one call. Takes the thread ID. Returns the thread ID and, for each message in it, the message ID and whether it is still in Trash. Messages Gmail has already deleted from Trash are gone and are not in the answer.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

thread_id.description: The ID of the thread to take out of Trash.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_untrash_thread
